description_good_justification: README describes QMD MCP as a unified Streamable HTTP MCP server for read access and bounded QMD index administration. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README documents installation and use; GitHub Issues accept feedback; CONTRIBUTING.md documents contributions. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/README.md
contribution_justification: Contribution workflow, security-reporting route, testing, dependency review, and release expectations are documented. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents JavaScript style, fail-closed boundary expectations, mandatory tests for functional changes, and the authoritative Docker validation gate. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The project is released under the MIT license. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open-source license.
license_location_justification: The full license text is in LICENSE at the repository root. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: README documents purpose, quick start, Docker deployment, configuration, validation, security boundary, releases, and upstream relationship. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: README documents the nine-tool MCP surface, transport, inputs/outputs, write-capable administration tools, and source-relative path handoff. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/README.md
sites_https_justification: The project repository, issues, releases, and GHCR distribution are served over HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests provide public, searchable, URL-addressable project discussion. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/issues
english_justification: The public source documentation, contribution policy, security policy, changelog, and commit messages are in English.
maintained_justification: The repository is actively maintained with current commits, CI/security work, and releases through v0.1.3 on 2026-08-19. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/commits/main
repo_public_justification: The complete source repository is public. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp
repo_track_justification: git tracks source changes and public history on GitHub.
repo_interim_justification: Interim changes are published as commits and pull requests on the public repository between releases.
repo_distributed_justification: git is a distributed version-control system.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique SemVer version, git tag, GitHub Release, and immutable container digest. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/releases
version_semver_justification: Published releases use Semantic Versioning-style vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tags: v0.1.0 through v0.1.3. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/tags
version_tags_justification: Every published release uses a matching vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH git tag. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md records user-relevant changes for v0.1.0 through v0.1.3 and GitHub Releases record immutable image digests. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: There are no publicly known qmd-mcp vulnerabilities to identify in release notes. CHANGELOG.md explicitly records the security status for every current release. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_process_justification: Bug reports and feature requests are accepted through GitHub Issues and documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is the public issue tracker. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/issues
report_responses_justification: The repository is younger than two months and currently has zero GitHub issues, so there are no eligible older bug reports without a response. The public reporting process is active. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/issues
enhancement_responses_justification: The repository currently has zero GitHub issues, so there are no eligible enhancement requests without a response. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/issues
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides a public searchable archive with stable issue URLs. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md instructs reporters to use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting and states what information to include. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting as documented in SECURITY.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received during the project's lifetime, so there is no report-response sample to measure. SECURITY.md commits to initial response within 14 days. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: The pinned Dockerfile plus package-lock.json builds the complete runtime image from a clean checkout, executes compatibility patching and tests, and prunes development-only dependencies. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/Dockerfile
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses standard Node/npm and Docker/BuildKit tooling documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
build_floss_tools_justification: The build and test path uses open-source Node.js/npm, Docker-compatible BuildKit tooling, node:test, and fast-check.
test_justification: The repository contains automated unit and property tests and CI also performs a real MCP initialize/list-tools/index-update smoke test. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/tree/main/tests
test_invocation_justification: `npm test` invokes the repository test suite and is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: The project does not currently publish a statement/branch coverage measurement, so it does not claim that most implementation code is covered.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The authoritative Docker build and MCP smoke validation run in GitHub Actions; the protected branches require the `image` status check. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires every functional change to add or update automated tests and asks for regression/property tests on security-sensitive boundaries. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent request-size and lexical-only policy changes include dedicated unit/property tests in the public repository. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/tree/main/tests
tests_documented_added_justification: The mandatory test policy is public in CONTRIBUTING.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: The authored implementation is JavaScript ES modules rather than a warning-configurable compiled language; the Docker gate runs Node syntax checks on project and patched upstream JavaScript.
warnings_fixed_justification: There is no compiler-warning stream for the authored JavaScript. Syntax or test failures fail the Docker build and CI.
warnings_strict_justification: Compiler warning-level flags do not apply to the authored JavaScript ES modules.
know_secure_design_justification: The primary maintainer self-certified this criterion as Met in OpenSSF Best Practices project 14153 on 2026-08-19. Project-level evidence for secure design principles and their current implementation is documented in docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md
know_common_errors_justification: The primary maintainer self-certified this criterion as Met in OpenSSF Best Practices project 14153 on 2026-08-19. Common OWASP/CWE-style weakness classes and project mitigations are documented in docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md
crypto_published_justification: qmd-mcp does not implement or define a cryptographic algorithm or protocol.
crypto_call_justification: The runtime does not implement an application cryptographic protocol; release signing and attestation are external GitHub/Sigstore supply-chain controls.
crypto_floss_justification: No cryptographic algorithm is implemented by qmd-mcp.
crypto_keylength_justification: qmd-mcp does not manage cryptographic keys or choose cryptographic key lengths.
crypto_working_justification: qmd-mcp does not implement an application cryptographic algorithm or protocol.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: qmd-mcp does not select application cryptographic algorithms; deployment transport security is provided by the external trusted/authenticated boundary.
crypto_pfs_justification: qmd-mcp does not terminate or configure TLS.
crypto_password_storage_justification: qmd-mcp does not implement user accounts or password storage.
crypto_random_justification: qmd-mcp does not generate cryptographic keys, passwords, or session secrets.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source, releases, and container distribution use HTTPS through GitHub/GHCR, and release consumers can pin the immutable OCI digest. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/releases
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release downloads are HTTPS-delivered; v0.1.3 additionally publishes a Sigstore attestation bundle and the OCI image has GitHub/SLSA attestations. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/releases/tag/v0.1.3
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unpatched project vulnerabilities. Dependabot/OSV and OpenSSF Vulnerabilities checks are clean; SECURITY.md targets publicly disclosed fixes within 60 days. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: There are no known critical qmd-mcp vulnerabilities or unresolved critical dependency advisories.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub Secret Scanning and Push Protection are enabled, public CI does not use production credentials, and the repository currently has no secret-scanning alerts.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL default setup analyzes JavaScript/TypeScript and GitHub Actions and runs on pull requests/main. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/security/code-scanning
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL queries common vulnerability classes for JavaScript/TypeScript and workflow code.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Current qmd-mcp CodeQL analyses are green; protected branch CI prevents merging when the required build/test check fails.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL default setup runs continuously on pull requests and main-branch updates.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The automated suite includes fast-check property-based randomized testing of request byte limits and lexical-only search policy; OpenSSF Scorecard v5.5.0 detects this as Fuzzing. https://github.com/X1pheR/qmd-mcp/blob/main/tests/property-policy.test.js
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The authored project code is JavaScript/Node.js rather than an unsafe-memory language requiring ASAN/Valgrind-style memory checks.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests use assertions, but the project does not claim pervasive production-runtime assertions solely to improve dynamic analysis.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Property and integration tests are part of the protected CI gate and must pass before merging to protected branches.
